Vacancy for Staff Nurse
Thursday, 23 January 2025
7498 Hits
Applications are invited on the prescribed format along with attested copies of certificates and experience certificates for the following post along with attested copies of certificates and testimonials of educational qualification and experience certificates, so as to reach the Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram, Dist. Wardha 442102 on or before 06/02/2025.
click here to download the form
Staff Nurse – 07 Post (1- ST, 1- VJ/NT, 2 – EWS, 3- Open)
Qualification & Experience:
The candidate must have passed Diploma in General Nursing & Midwifery, B.Sc. Nursing/Post. B.Sc. and should be registered with Maharashtra Nursing Council, Mumbai with minimum 1-year experience in a 100 bedded Hospital, the candidate must know the basic resuscitation & those who have worked in intensive care unit of Medicine, Surgery, Neurosurgery, Accidental trauma (Emergency Department) will be preferred.
Age Limit
: Between 18 to 38 years for General Candidate/ between 18-43 for reserved candidate
General Notes
Candidates applying for reserve category post should submit caste certificate & caste validity certificate and also recent non-creamy layer certificate, wherever applicable.
The benefits of reservation shall be admissible to the backward class/ category candidates who are domiciled in the state of Maharashtra only.
Registration with Local Employment Exchange is mandatory.
Age limit, Educational Qualifications and experience shall be considered up-to last date of the application.
NOC certificate from the present employer is mandatory.
Age limit and or Experience can be relaxed by the appointing authority for otherwise qualified candidate.
Only eligible candidates will be called for Written / Skill test and shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification / Interview.
Number of post may vary
Pay Scale is as per KHS rule
Medical Superintendent
Swachhata Pakhwada - 2025
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
